title: InstanceParameters
description: Configuration parameters for an SAP HANA Cloud service instance defining resource allocation, features, and operational settings.

edition.description: The SAP HANA Cloud edition. Determines available features and resource limits.

memory.description: The allocated memory for the SAP HANA database in gigabytes. Determines the in-memory data capacity.

vcpu.description: The number of virtual CPUs allocated to the SAP HANA database instance.

storage.description: The allocated persistent storage in gigabytes for data that exceeds in-memory capacity using native storage extensions.

systempassword.description: The system database user password. Required during instance creation and can be updated via instance modification.

whitelistIPs.description: List of IP addresses or CIDR ranges allowed to connect to the database instance. An empty list blocks all external connections.

enabledservices.description: Optional database services to enable on the instance.

scriptserver.description: Enable the script server for running application function libraries (AFL) including PAL and BFL.

docstore.description: Enable the JSON document store for semi-structured data storage and querying.

dpserver.description: Enable the data provisioning server for smart data integration and real-time replication.

serviceStopped.description: Controls the running state of the instance. Set to true to stop the instance and false to start it. A stopped instance does not consume compute resources but retains all data.

availabilityZone.description: The availability zone within the selected region where the instance is deployed.

slaLevel.description: The service level agreement tier for the instance.
